systems.name: DCD Research-to-Publishing System
systems.short: From public signal to published insight.
systems.text: A connected research and publishing workflow: qualify source material, develop a draft, apply editorial review, and deliver it to the website.
systems.note: Gemini supports research and drafting. OpenAI supports editorial review and image generation. Publishing runs through GitHub and Netlify.

systems.name: DCD Project Discovery System
systems.short: From an open question to a structured brief.
systems.text: Gemini-assisted discovery turns an initial conversation into structured intake. Deterministic rules qualify the project before records, a brief, and follow-up are created.
systems.note: Model-assisted conversation. Rule-based qualification. Each has a distinct job.

capabilities.name: AI systems
capabilities.text: Research, extraction, classification, and knowledge tools built around a defined task.

capabilities.name: Automation + integration
capabilities.text: APIs and repeatable workflows that connect the tools your business already uses.

capabilities.name: Data + intelligence
capabilities.text: Structured records, useful reporting, and clear paths from information to decisions.

capabilities.name: Digital products
capabilities.text: Purpose-built interfaces that make the system usable for the people doing the work.
